title: Chapter 134 — Post-Sale Follow-Up
intro: The sale does not end at delivery — it begins a relationship.

sections.title: The Follow-Up Cadence
sections.content:
Delivery day check-in: 'Hi [name], just checking that everything went smoothly with your delivery today. Any issues at all, call me directly.' This call takes 30 seconds and catches problems while they are small — before they become 1-star reviews.

48-hour call: 'How is the new dishwasher working? Any questions about features or settings?' This is your first coaching moment — most customers only use 20 percent of their appliance's features. Walk them through one or two they might not have discovered.

One-week follow-up for complex installations — ranges with gas connections, built-in refrigeration with panel work, laundry stacking kits. These have a higher rate of issues that show up in the first week.

30-day check-in: 'Everything still running great? By the way, if you know anyone shopping for appliances, I would love the chance to help them.' This is the referral and review window — satisfaction peaks around 30 days.

sections.title: Asking for Reviews
sections.content:
The best window for asking is 48 hours to one week after delivery. The customer is excited about their new appliance. Satisfaction is at its peak. Wait longer and the excitement fades into routine.

'Would you mind leaving a quick review? It helps our store and it helps me personally.' Include a direct link to the Google review page. Make it one click. Every additional step between your ask and the review cuts conversion in half.

Do not mass-blast review requests. Personal asks from the rep who sold them convert 5-10 times higher than automated emails from the store. Your name matters. Your relationship matters.

sections.title: Most Stores Stop Here — You Won't
sections.content:
Most stores ignore the customer after the truck leaves. The ones that do not build empires. Your post-sale follow-up system is what separates a $60K career from a $120K career.

Every follow-up call is a retention touchpoint. Every check-in is a referral opportunity. Every resolved issue is a loyalty deposit. The customers you follow up with become the customers who follow you — to a new store, to a new brand, for the next 20 years.

Set up your CRM to automate the reminders: delivery day, 48 hours, one week, 30 days, six months (water filter reminder), one year (anniversary touch). The system does the remembering. You do the calling.
